name: sysmon-config-manager
description: Sysmon Config Matrix & Multi-Manager - import, diff, and batch-edit Sysmon configs across multiple network environments.
notes: This project runs with zero build step: all dependencies below are loaded as ES modules at runtime, from the already-populated ./vendor/ folder by default (works fully offline out of the box), or from esm.sh if you switch modes (see requirements/dependencies.json). `npm run serve` only needs Python's built-in static server - no Node install required, and none of package.json/node_modules is actually used at runtime. The `dev`/`build`/`preview` scripts are provided for later migration to a bundled Vite + TypeScript setup and require `npm install` with Node.js available.
